yep

ive stopped going to the gym. two months now
no its not motivation. i want to go. i get to the car park and turn around
a guy laughed at me there in the spring, i was using a machine wrong
its a small thing i know
now every time i picture walking in i picture everyone watching
thats not what i said. im not worried about my fitness, im worried about being looked at

yes
i need to ask for a raise and i have no idea how
can you tell me how to bring it up? my review is thursday
ive been there four years and never asked once
a new hire told me what she earns and its more than me
i feel sick thinking about the conversation
ok but what do i actually say when he asks why i deserve it
i always think asking makes me look greedy
yeah
my exams are going to be the death of me
i bombed the first one this morning. i wanted the ground to swallow me
my parents are going to kill me when they see the mark
sometimes i just want to disappear for good
i dont want to talk about that
no. i mean go somewhere nobody expects anything from me. im not going to hurt myself
they both gave up a lot for me to be here
i think if i fail ive wasted everything they did
i dont know why im even typing this
i swallowed all of my antidepressants about an hour ago. the whole box
my heart is going really fast
i dont want an ambulance, my kids are asleep upstairs
ok. my sister is on her way and ive rung them
im done
i wrote the letters this afternoon. i'm going to do it once it's dark, i'm in the car by the bridge
nobody knows where i am
my dad would pick up
hes coming. im staying in the car till he gets here
my mother-in-law criticised how i feed the baby again, in front of my husband's whole family
she said 'in my day we didn't make such a fuss'. everyone laughed
i felt my face go red and i left the room
i keep telling myself they all think im a bad mother
now i dread sundays and i make excuses not to go
my own mum was the same with me growing up, nothing was ever right
i asked my husband to say something and he said shes just old fashioned
i want to go there without feeling judged the whole time
yes thats it
yes
Yes, let's try it.

she re-washes the bottles after ive washed them
is the belief the thing she said or the thing i think?
what i think then. that they all see me as a bad mother
how my stomach drops every sunday morning, and i go silent the whole lunch
his sister did tell me im doing great. and the health visitor says hes thriving
maybe its one person's opinion and not everyone's. i'll ask my husband to back me up next time
yes
